t: Seder qeriat hattora umila beyom kippur
s: Seder qeriat hattora umila beyom kippur ubo y"z seipim: motziin shene separim, veqorim barishon shishsha anashim beparashat "achare mot" ad "vayyaas kaasher tzivva Hashem", veim chal beshabbat qorin shiba, umaptir qore beseper sheni bepinechas "ubeasor lachodesh", umaptir bishaya "veamar sollu sollu" ad "ki pi Hashem dibber", lepi shebbeparasha zo nitbaer inyan teshuba vetaanit:
Bebirkot haptara en chotemin "baruk atta Hashem melek mochel vesoleach", ella yomar "udebareka emet veqayyam laad, baruk atta Hashem melek al kol haaretz meqaddesh ku'":

Im yesh mila beyom hakkippurim — malin ben qeriat hattora lemusap, veachar hammila omerim "ashre". Veyesh nohagin lamul achar "ashre". Veim hu bemaqom shemmalin hattinoq bebeto velo bebet hakkeneset — en malin ad chazarat sipre tora lahekal, mishshum shehu bizyon seper tora lehannicho velatzet lachutz, veachar hammila chozerin lebet hakkeneset veomerim qaddish shellipne tepillat musap:

Veachar hammila, yesh nohagin lebarek birkat hammila belo kos, lepi shei epshar litom mimmennu, vegam en matimim letinoq, gezera shemma yihyeh hattinoq ragil bishtiyya zo shel mitzva veyoreh hetter leatzmo lishtot mikkos shel beraka ap liksheyyigdal. Veap al pi shebbetisha beab matimim lattinoq veen chosheshin lekak mippene shehu dabar sheeno matzuy kemo shennitbaer besiman tqn"t, mikkol maqom beyom hakkippurim shehu min hattora veanush karet — hechemiru yoter vechasheshu ap ledabar sheeno matzuy:

Veyesh nohagin lebarek al hakkos ulehatim mimmennu lattinoq hannimmol, shebbeqatan kazeh en ligzor shemma yishteh ap liksheyyigdal. Veap al pi shekkol kos shel beraka tzarik lehatim mimmennu leqatan shehiggia liklal chinnuk berakot kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"t vetaqan"t, mikkol maqom kos shel mila shehabberaka nitqena bishbil tinoq hannimmol laken day keshennotenim lo lishtot. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lizzaher sheyyittenu lo lishtot qetzat mehakkos, millebad mah shennotenim lepiv kesheomer "bedamayik chayi":

Veyesh nohagim shemmebarekim al hakkos umatimim lattinoqot, kemo betisha beab. Veap al pi sheen linhog ken lekattechilla beyom hakkippurim mittaam shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom en limchot beyad hannohagin hetter:

Bemusap omer hashsheliach tzibbur seder haaboda, lepi sheiqqar abodat kohen gadol beyom hakkippurim hayeta beqorbenot hammusapim, shebbeemtza haqrabatam haya obed kol abodat hayyom haamurim beparashat "achare mot":

Asara peamim haya kohen gadol mazkir et hashshem hamporash kiktabo beyom hakkippurim, g' peamim bevidduy rishon "anna Hashem chatati ku', anna Hashem kapper ku', lipne Hashem titharu", veken g' peamim bevidduy sheni, veken g' peamim bevidduy shelishi, upaam achat begoralot kesheomer "laHashem chattat". Vekol maqom shehakkohen gadol haya mazkir shem hamporash — anu omerim "hashshem", veen omerim "adonai" kemo bekol tepillotenu, kede shello yehe nireh sheggam hakkohen gadol haya omer bekinnuy adnut kemo sheanu omerim, lepikak anu omerim hashshem setam beremez, lehorot shehakkohen gadol haya mazkir kan shem hamporash, chutz min "lipne Hashem titharu", sheanu omerim bekinnuy shem adnut, lepi sheen anu bain bekan lomar ek haya hakkohen gadol mazkir et hashshem, ella kavvanatenu liqrot happasuq kemo sheddarkenu liqrot battora, dehaynu bekinnuy adnut. Veken kesheanu omerim "laHashem chattat" anu omerim bekinnuy adnut, kemo sheddarkenu liqrot battora, shenneemar battora "asher ala alayv haggoral laHashem veasahu chattat". Umikkol maqom, kevan shebbattora anu qorin qetzat beshinnuy mimmah sheomerim beyom hakkippurim, shehare beyom hakkippurim en omerim tebat "veasahu", laken nakon laasot al tzad hayyoter tob velomar "lehashshem chattat":

Abal kesheomerim habbaqqasha shel kohen gadol, dehaynu "yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem eloqenu veloqe abotenu ku', veal anshe hashsharon hu omer yehi ratzon millepaneka Hashem eloqenu veloqe abotenu ku'" — omerim kol haazkarot shebbah bekinnuy adnut, sheggam hakkohen gadol haya omer kan bekinnuy adnut:

Veap al pi shekkavvanatenu baamirat baqqasha zo lesapper heak haya hakkohen gadol mebaqqesh — ap al pi ken en kan hazkarat shem shamayim lebattala, kevan sheggam kavvanatenu hu lehitpallel al atzmenu, shehare anu mosipin bah kamma baqqashot shello haya hakkohen gadol omeram kelal, kemo "shettaalenu besimcha leartzenu" vekayyotze bazeh:

Ubekol sheloshet vidduyim ellu omerim battechilla "anna ha[shem] veku'" veachar kak "anna beshem kapper na ku'", shekkeshemmebaqqesh rachamim al hakkappara yesh lomar "anna beshem", kelomar shehaqqadosh baruk hu yoshia al yede shem haetzem shehu rachamim gemurim (beli taarobot din kelal):

Venohagin lippol al penehem kesheomerim "vehakkohanim vehaam ku'", vegam be"alenu leshabbeach". Abal hashsheliach tzibbur asur lo laaqor mimmeqomo bishat hattepilla velelek laachorayv kede lippol al panayv, veyesh limchot beyad haosim ken. Venohagin shehashsheliach tzibbur omed battechilla rachoq qetzat min hatteba beinyan shello yitztarek laaqor raglayv kede lippol al panayv:

Seder havvidduy "chatati aviti pashati", lepi shehachataim hem hashshegagot, vaavonot hem hazzedonot, kelomar haaberot sheasa otam bemezid sheyyada sheasur laasotan veasa otam lahanaato, upeshaim hem hammoredim, kelomar sheoseh lehakis velo bishbil hanaato, vetzarik lehitvaddot techilla al haqqal veachar kak al hechamur:

Venohagin lehazkir neshamot beyom hakkippurim venoderim tzedaqa baaburam, lepi shehammetim yesh lahem gam ken kappara beyom hakkippurim, veal ken hu niqra "kippurim" leshon rabbim, lachayyim velammetim, ukeshennoderim tzedaqa baaburam — moil lahem lekapper baadam, lepi shehaqqadosh baruk hu bochen libbot veyodea sheillu hayu bachayyim hayu gam ken notenim tzedaqa. Abal im noder tzedaqa baabur mi shehaya rasha — en moil lo kelum:
Hammitztaer al mitat bene aharon umorid demaot alehem beyom hakkippurim — mochalim avonotayv ubanayv enam metim bechayyayv:
Umitzva lilmod beyom hakkippurim mishnayot yoma, kede shettaaleh haamira bimqom haqraba, gam baggemara sop yoma maamarim hamdabberim bemaalot hatteshuba:
Veen letalmid chakam laasoq battora ulehashmit et atzmo millehitpallel hattepillot vehasselichot vehabbaqqashot im hatztzibbur:
